name: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® BG®

breadcrumb.name: Green Roofs and Green Walls Systems

tagline: WATER ATTENUATING PLANTING TRAY MODULES FOR EXTENSIVE GREEN ROOFS
summary: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® BG® is a lightweight planting tray designed for extensive blue green roofs and functions as a water retaining tray, water attenuation tray, and a drainage mat. Modules are manufactured from recycled polypropylene (PP), and consist of three layers: a planting layer, an irrigation reservoir area, and a stormwater attenuation layer. SikaRoof® VersiDrain® BG® interlock with adjacent modules for easy installation and has a smooth base for safe placement directly over the waterproofing membrane. Its internal irrigation reservoir promotes plant sustainability and its stormwater attenuation layer collects and slowly releases at-source stormwater to mititgate overburdening of drainage infrastructures amidst our current crisis.
metaDescription: See how SikaRoof® VersiDrain® BG® blue green roof trays combine planting, irrigation and stormwater attenuation layers to slowly release at-source stormwater.

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance with the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Bundles must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements

items.label: Water retention
items.text:
Water Reservoir Capacity | Water Retention Capacity
10 L/m2 | 40 L/m2

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text: Clean and sound surface shall have at least a wood float finish. All holes, joints, and cracks and honeycombs in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be filled with an approved grout and allowed to cure. High spots in concrete or masonry surfaces shall be cut off or ground down to prevent damage/puncture to the water retention planting tray module.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: SikaRoof® VersiDrain® BG® shall be loosely laid and interlocked with adjacent modules connected by proprietary clips to form a continuous water retention and drainage layer without any mechanical fixing either on top of the waterproofing membrane or on top of the concrete surface. The installed water retention and drainage modules would then be covered with an approved or Sika® geotextile filter fabric before pouring the planting media into the modules.
